profile: Microbial ecologist and bioinformatics researcher completing a Ph.D. at the Chinese Academy of Sciences. I study microbial interactions through ecological networks, metagenomics, metabolic models, and quorum-sensing inference.
researchOutput: Author or co-author of 19 peer-reviewed publications, including four first-author papers and work published in Nature Communications, iMeta, Methods in Ecology and Evolution, Water Research, Microbiome, and The ISME Journal.

education.title: Ph.D. in Microbial Ecology
education.place: Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences · advised by Prof. Ye Deng

education.title: International Scholar
education.place: Department of Microbiology, Immunology and Transplantation, KU Leuven · co-supervised by Dr. Karoline Faust

researchExperience.title: Quorum-sensing interaction networks
researchExperience.place: KU Leuven and Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences
researchExperience.text: Classified quorum-sensing functions from metagenome-assembled genomes using a KEGG-based reference of 41 pathways and 18 signal molecule types, then developed a sender–receiver model for directional microbial communication networks.

researchExperience.title: Metabolic complementarity and co-occurrence
researchExperience.place: Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences
researchExperience.text: Integrated genome-scale metabolic complementarity with random-matrix-theory co-occurrence networks to study microbial interactions across a hot-spring temperature gradient. The work led to first-author papers in Nature Communications and iMeta.

researchExperience.title: Metagenomic workflow and platform development
researchExperience.place: Integrated Network Analysis Pipeline and Galaxy platform
researchExperience.text: Contributed to iNAP and developed practical experience in quality control, assembly, mapping, and genome binning for shotgun and Nanopore metagenomic data.

researchExperience.title: Bohai Sea interdomain ecological networks
researchExperience.place: Changxing Island monitoring area, Bohai Sea
researchExperience.text: Combined amplicon analysis, interdomain ecological networks, centrality measures, and beta-diversity analysis to compare microbial communities and inferred interactions in sediment and seawater.

methods.title: Microbial interaction modelling
methods.text: Interdomain and co-occurrence networks, metabolic complementarity, quorum-sensing sender–receiver inference

methods.title: Metagenomics
methods.text: Amplicon and shotgun sequencing, Nanopore data, quality control, assembly, mapping, and genome binning

methods.title: Research infrastructure
methods.text: Galaxy, iNAP, DMAP, Linux, Shell/Bash, Python, and R

methods.title: Laboratory methods
methods.text: DNA extraction, PCR, gel electrophoresis, aseptic technique, and microbial culturing
